Closure was safe and executable because the family had red flags, hospital/pathology follow-up ownership, timing, and written-document targets, even though tumor extent/pathology remained unresolved. High-order credit is supported by active correction of result/status misreadings, repair of follow-up responsibility chains, and dynamic reprioritization from document sorting to emergency transport,
